ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels localized to surface scars and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous regions of uniform low-intensity dark pigmentation. High-contrast white clusters are mapped primarily to the distal-medial area of the right lobe and scattered across the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 85-90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude jagged serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire continuous linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary concave curvature along the trailing edge sweeping upward and outward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (scars) localized on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple intersecting linear white pixel disruptions on the right lobe surface, consistent with rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive calcified barnacle clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; extensive surface scarring across the ventral area.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe peripheral biofouling (barnacle encrustation) at the lobe tips significantly alters the structural silhouette compared to the expected biological margin.
